SELECT product.id AS id, product.merchant_id AS merchant_id, product.name AS name, product.category_id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, product.price AS price, product.stock AS stock, product.description AS description, product.image AS image, m.shop_name AS shop_name FROM product JOIN category c ON product.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.user_id = product.merchant_id WHERE product.id = #{id} AND product.status = 1 AND product.audit_status = 1
